title: Ask's endurance

infobox.Effects: Run stamina usage: -10% | Jump stamina usage: -10% | Attack stamina usage: -20% | Pierce: +10%

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Ask's endurance is a status effect granted by wearing the Ask armor set.
It reduces stamina from running and jumping by 10%, from attacking by 20% and increases pierce damage by 10%.
